name: testsmt17.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))

(define-sort Set (T) (Array T Bool))

; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (max Int)(instA Ref)(X Int)(Y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (a_500 Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (b_1000 Int)))))
(declare-sort C) (declare-const mk-C C)

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-A this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-B this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-C this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.max: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!max ((this Ref)) Int
  (max (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.instA: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!instA ((this Ref)) Ref
  (instA (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.X: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.X ((this Ref)) Int
  (X (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!X ((this Ref)) Int
  (X (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.Y: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.Y ((this Ref)) Int
  (Y (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!Y ((this Ref)) Int
  (Y (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.a_500: ---

(define-fun A.a_500 ((this Ref)) Int
  (a_500 (deref-A this))
)

(define-fun A!a_500 ((this Ref)) Int
  (a_500 (deref-A this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class B:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for B.b_1000: ---

(define-fun B!b_1000 ((this Ref)) Int
  (b_1000 (deref-B this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Methods for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.double ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (+ x x)
)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!double ((this Ref)(x Int)) Int
  (+ x x)
)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.sum ((this Ref)) Int
  (+ (TopLevelDeclarations.X this) (TopLevelDeclarations.Y this))
)

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!sum ((this Ref)) Int
  (+ (TopLevelDeclarations!X this) (TopLevelDeclarations!Y this))
)

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-A (TopLevelDeclarations!instA this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert298))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!max this) 1000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert299))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (TopLevelDeclarations!X this) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert300))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (TopLevelDeclarations!Y this) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert301))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-A A)
(declare-const const-2-A A)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun A.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!double 0 (A!a_500 this)) (TopLevelDeclarations!max 0))
)

(assert (! (A.inv1 1) :named _xkassert302))
(assert (! (A.inv1 2) :named _xkassert303))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-B B)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun B.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (B!b_1000 this) (TopLevelDeclarations!double 0 (A.a_500 (TopLevelDeclarations!instA 0))))
)

(assert (! (B.inv1 3) :named _xkassert304))



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-C C)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun C.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (+ (TopLevelDeclarations!X 0) (TopLevelDeclarations!Y 0)) 10)
)

(assert (! (C.inv1 4) :named _xkassert305))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun C.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (TopLevelDeclarations!sum 0 ) 10)
)

(assert (! (C.inv2 4) :named _xkassert306))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-A const-1-A))
        2 (lift-A const-2-A))
        3 (lift-B const-3-B))
        4 (lift-C const-4-C))
  )
)
smtModel:
;; universe for C:
;;   C!val!0 
;; -----------
;; definitions for universe elements:
(declare-fun C!val!0 () C)
;; cardinality constraint:
(forall ((x C)) (= x C!val!0))
;; -----------
(define-fun const-1-A () A
  (mk-A 500))
(define-fun const-2-A () A
  (mk-A 500))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1000 2 8 2))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (_ as-array k!5))
(define-fun const-3-B () B
  (mk-B 1000))
(define-fun const-4-C () C
  C!val!0)
(define-fun k!3 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-A (mk-A 500))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 500))
  (ite (= x!1 0)
    (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1000 2 8 2))
    null))))
(define-fun k!0 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  null)
(define-fun k!4 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 3) (lift-B (mk-B 1000))
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-A (mk-A 500))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 500))
  (ite (= x!1 0)
    (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1000 2 8 2))
    null)))))
(define-fun k!1 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 0)
    (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1000 2 8 2))
    null))
(define-fun k!5 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 2) (lift-A (mk-A 500))
  (ite (= x!1 3) (lift-B (mk-B 1000))
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 500))
  (ite (= x!1 0)
    (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1000 2 8 2))
  (ite (= x!1 4) (lift-C C!val!0)
    null))))))
(define-fun k!2 ((x!1 Int)) Any
  (ite (= x!1 1) (lift-A (mk-A 500))
  (ite (= x!1 0)
    (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1000 2 8 2))
    null)))
